description: This file defines models and a fetcher class for handling BLS (Bureau of Labor Statistics) series data, including query parameters, data structures, and data extraction logic from the BLS API.

classes.name: BlsSeriesQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for BLS series requests, including options for calculations, annual averages, and aspects.

classes.name: BlsSeriesData
classes.description: Represents individual data points for BLS series, including change metrics and footnotes.

classes.name: BlsSeriesFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming BLS series data from the API, including asynchronous data extraction and validation.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a BlsSeriesQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches BLS series data from the API, handling request chunking and error management.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into sorted BlsSeriesData instances, applying date filters and warnings.
